title: Paul McCartney live: Isleta Amphitheater, Albuquerque | 2025
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Isleta Amphitheater in Albuquerque, New Mexico, USA, on 7 October 2025.

It was the fourth show of the Got Back North American Tour 2025. The Got Back Tour lasted for 80 dates between April 2022 and November 2025.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).
